tools.name: audit_preview
tools.description: Free preview of a Smartsheet workflow audit: score, grade, issue counts and top 3 issue types. Rate-limited. Accepts sheet JSON, {sheet}, top-level columns/rows, or csv text.

tools.name: audit_smartsheet
tools.description: Smartsheet workflow audit: formulas, column types, hierarchy/predecessors, duplicates, blanks, size, sharing and automation risks. Returns score, findings with severity + fix, and a markdown report. Costs $0.10 USDC on eip155:8453 via x402 (payTo 0x7a16ea540a69ff288a34dc276c638fc3fe9f586c); without

tools.name: leave_feedback
tools.description: Free. Tell us why you did not pay for audit_smartsheet (or other feedback). Preferred reason values: price_too_high, no_wallet, input_format, not_needed, other (unknown values stored as other). Also accepts feedback/comment/text fields. Message truncated to 500 chars.
